rule: 'kNN reference set = train + val' (GO-GPT validation proteins added as references to the sharpened kNN prior T5_k50_g0_na; TV v2 queries copy val labels stripped to T0 by the TV v2 dated GOA rule; DIAMOND --more-sensitive e<=1e-3 top 50 by bitscore over the merged train+val hits) is KEPT if its TV v2 test-like mean Fmax (chosen_v2 cell weights, knn_sharp.Scorer) minus the train-only prior's is >= 0.003, the paired protein bootstrap 95% CI of that difference (1000 reps, seed 0, test-like weights) excludes 0, and the plain (unweighted) TV v2 mean Fmax is not lower by more than 0.002. Weights recomputed from train+val cells are a diagnostic only. Keeping it writes data/proc_gogpt_tv2/knn_trainval/{tv,test}_knn.npz but does not by itself trigger a test look.
